description: Findings and acceptance by lane, verifier refutation, held-back counts and fixes (spec §12.5).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.lane AS "Lane", f.state AS "State", count(*) AS "Findings"
FROM findings f JOIN rule_runs rr ON rr.id = f.rule_run_id JOIN reviews r ON r.id = rr.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND $__timeFilter(f.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 3 DESC

SELECT coalesce(f.suppressed_reason, '(none)') AS "Reason", count(*) AS "Findings"
FROM findings f JOIN rule_runs rr ON rr.id = f.rule_run_id JOIN reviews r ON r.id = rr.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND f.state <> 'posted' AND $__timeFilter(f.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: A rule refuted more than half the time needs a better prompt.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.rule_id AS "Rule", count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.verify_verdict IS NOT NULL) AS "Verified",
  round(avg((f.verify_verdict = 'refuted')::int) FILTER (WHERE f.verify_verdict IS NOT NULL), 3) AS "Refuted",
  round(avg((f.verify_verdict = 'uncertain')::int) FILTER (WHERE f.verify_verdict IS NOT NULL), 3) AS "Uncertain",
  round(avg(f.verify_same_family::int) FILTER (WHERE f.verify_verdict IS NOT NULL), 3) AS "Same family"
FROM findings f JOIN rule_runs rr ON rr.id = f.rule_run_id JOIN reviews r ON r.id = rr.review_id
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
GROUP BY f.rule_id HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.verify_verdict IS NOT NULL) > 0 ORDER BY "Refuted" DESC

panels.title: Verifier refutation by rule

panels.description: Share of posted findings with a suggested fix, how many validated, and how many were committed (applied_suggestion).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.rule_id AS "Rule", count(*) AS "Posted",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.suggested_fix IS NOT NULL) AS "With fix",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.fix_valid) AS "Valid fix",
  count(DISTINCT e.finding_id) AS "Applied"
FROM findings f JOIN rule_runs rr ON rr.id = f.rule_run_id JOIN reviews r ON r.id = rr.review_id
LEFT JOIN feedback_events e ON e.finding_id = f.id AND e.kind = 'applied_suggestion'
WHERE r.caller = 'production' AND f.gh_comment_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(f.created_at)
GROUP BY f.rule_id ORDER BY "Posted" DESC

panels.title: Fixes

targets.rawSql:
SELECT o.lane AS "Lane", count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen) AS "Posted",
  round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND o.accepted)::numeric
        / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE o.seen AND (o.accepted OR o.rejected OR o.ignored)), 0), 3) AS "Acceptance",
  round(sum(o.neg_w)::numeric / nullif(sum(o.neg_w + o.pos_w), 0)::numeric, 3) AS "eFP (weighted)"
FROM finding_outcomes o WHERE $__timeFilter(o.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
